definitions.batch_noise: matched_small_base - original H12-cap base cache; includes observed batch/lane execution differences
definitions.matched_memory_delta: memory at the H12-base-reference prewrite state minus matched-small base
definitions.actual_residual_delta: memory minus original H12-cap base cache; sum of batch_noise and matched_memory_delta
definitions.block_quantiles: NumPy linear quantiles, one equally weighted observation per write block
definitions.pooled_concat_norm: square root of sum of squared block L2 norms; larger tensors contribute more
definitions.null_ratio: denominator <= recorded 1e-12 L2 floor; empty-state signal is exactly zero, not an infinite reported ratio
definitions.statistical_scope: 61 correlated blocks from 12 trajectories in one fixed group; descriptive distributions, not independent replicates
definitions.norm_ratio_interpretation: ratio of L2 norms is not a fraction of additive energy; components have nonzero cosine

independent_repeat.base_h12_definition: two autonomous writer trajectories from empty, using the SAME cached original H12 hidden blocks; not two independently re-encoded T0 trajectories
independent_repeat.memory_definition: two autonomous memory-encoded trajectories from empty, each re-encoding with its own prewrite state at every write

final_query_nll.reason: V2 scored ref and eps=0.01 perturbation conditions only; repeat states were not queried

evidence: All 12 empty-state blocks have exactly zero memory-minus-matched-base hidden and writer-feature differences; all old memory-minus-H12 differences are nonzero and equal the batch/lane difference.
Across 49 nonempty blocks, writer-feature batch-noise/matched-memory-delta L2 ratio has median 0.3194075684104028 and maximum 0.4305828140488762; this component is material.
Keep the original H12 frozen base writer and first residual feature half; use the matched-small baseline only for the residual difference.
The observed independent memory-repeat final relative errors are much larger than shared-H12 writer-repeat errors; this does not by itself locate the numerical mechanism or show contraction.
Repeat NLL remains unmeasured in V2; perturbation NLL must not be reported as repeat NLL.
limits: No proof that matched subtraction removes all between-call execution variability.
No training-quality or DEV64 improvement claim follows from these diagnostics.
Base repeat reuses H12 features, so it does not test native T0 re-encoding repeatability.
